sources.title: Security Incident | Recovery Update #3
claims: Binance says aggregate incident coverage has increased from approximately 80% to 90%.
Binance says BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC are fully backed at 100% in a new PoR snapshot taken 2026-10-31 00:00 UTC.
Binance says the remaining 10% consists of less-liquid tokens outside the ten named assets.
Binance says replenishment uses partial SAFU, a portion of the Futures Insurance Fund and corporate treasury.
Binance estimates full zk-SNARK proof generation by 2026-11-03 and targets withdrawal resumption on 2026-11-01.
limitations: Company statement; full proof was not available at capture.
No XRP-specific units, USD purchases, spot/OTC venue split or reserve-address crosswalk disclosed.
The 90% aggregate figure is not converted into a dollar amount or XRP demand.

sources.title: Proof of Reserves methodology
claims: Binance describes address ownership verification, user-liability snapshots, zk-SNARK proof generation and Merkle-tree inclusion verification.
limitations: Rendered page did not expose the full new asset-level table as machine-readable text at capture.
Methodology page is not an independent third-party audit.

sources.title: SBI VISA Crypto Card current product and reward terms
claims: One asset per card may be selected from BTC, ETH or XRP.
Standard card earns JPY 1 equivalent per JPY 200 spend; Gold earns JPY 2 equivalent per JPY 200 spend.
Monthly points for the 6th-to-5th cycle are credited around the 17th and converted by month-end into the selected crypto.
Conversion quantity uses SBI VC Trade's displayed sales price at 06:59:59 on the previous day; XRP units are truncated to seven decimals.

The September 1–October 31 campaign offers a JPY 500 joining benefit, Standard spending reward up to JPY 2,000 and Gold spending reward up to JPY 4,000; issuance by November 30, spend through December 5, reward by February 2027.
Campaign reward priority for multiple cards is Gold before Standard, then BTC before ETH before XRP.
limitations: No cardholder count, XRP selection share, reward units or realized aggregate credit volume disclosed.
Sales-price reference is not an execution record; reward inventory may come from existing inventory, OTC or spot purchases.
Campaign application window ends 2026-10-31 JST; current page terms are dynamic.

sources.title: Basic agreement to explore cooperation in digital finance and payments
claims: SBI Holdings and Visa Japan signed an exploratory basic agreement covering digital finance, payments and possible digital-asset/stablecoin use.
limitations: Exploratory MOU; no completed XRP product, Ripple contract or stablecoin issuance mandate established.

sources.publisher: SBI Shinsei Bank / SBI VC Trade
sources.title: Yen time-deposit campaign with XRP exchange vouchers
claims: The campaign offered XRP vouchers against eligible six-month yen deposits from JPY 300,000, with a maximum JPY 20,000 equivalent.
XRP quantity reference was 2026-07-02 06:59 JST.
limitations: Total eligible deposits, voucher issuance, redemption, XRP units credited and sourcing are not disclosed.

sources.title: SBI VC Trade begins handling Ripple USD (RLUSD)
claims: SBI VC Trade began handling Ripple's RLUSD on VCTRADE on 2026-06-24.
limitations: RLUSD is a Ripple-issued stablecoin distinct from native XRP; listing does not establish XRP purchases or collateral demand.

sources.title: Crypto exchanges call for quick moves to bolster defenses after Binance heist
claims: Reuters reports Coinbase said it adjusted systems that store cryptocurrency keys offline as a precaution after the Binance incident.
limitations: Exact control changes are undisclosed; this is a custody response, not evidence of an XRP-specific product, reserve or demand change.

sources.title: Current-main pull request, workflow and CI audit
claims: There are 190 open PRs: 180 drafts, 10 ready; 188 target main, five target the current main SHA and 183 are stale.
PRs #1413–#1417 are draft, unmerged and based on current main; their exact-head CI and fail-closed gates passed.
Main retains scheduled/manual write-capable workflows including cross-analysis, signal accuracy, scheduler tick and Databricks token rotation.
limitations: Branch-protection detail endpoint returned 403; required-check policy not independently inspected.
Full repository CI and dependency vulnerability scan were not run.
Local dirty-worktree state was not inspected.

independence_policy.primary_vs_secondary: Binance and SBI statements are primary company claims. Reuters is secondary reporting. GitHub state is direct repository observation.
independence_policy.non_independence: SBI/Visa card and MOU sources are related counterparties; do not count them as independent market corroboration.
independence_policy.actual_capital: Reward face value, exchange price reference and aggregate recovery coverage are not executed XRP purchases or net external capital.
